# The Eden Institute

> Publisher of Eden's Table, a Christian K-5 homeschool science and nature study curriculum, and of Back to Eden, a book on Biblical herbalism for adults. The Eden Institute teaches constitutional (Biblical) herbalism, the practice of matching herbs to a person's unique body pattern rather than to isolated symptoms, grounded in Scripture and clinical rigor. We also publish Eden's Table, a Christ-centered homeschool herbalism curriculum: Sprouts (K-2) and Seedlings (grades 3-5) are on sale now, with grades 6-12 planned.

## Core concepts
- [What Is Constitutional Herbalism?](https://edeninstitute.health/constitutional-herbalism): Constitutional (Biblical) herbalism matches herbs to the person, not the symptom. Covers the six tissue states (hot, cold, damp, dry, tense, relaxed), the Five Tenets of Health (Hydration, Movement, Nutrition, Rest, Connection), and the Scriptural basis for terrain-based plant medicine.
- [Why Eden](https://edeninstitute.health/why-eden): The worldview, philosophy, and founding conviction behind the Institute: a Western, biblically anchored alternative to Eastern and New Age frameworks.

## Programs
- [Eden's Table: Homeschool Herbalism Curriculum](https://edeninstitute.health/homeschool): A Christ-centered homeschool curriculum teaching Biblical herbalism and the body God designed, with open-and-go weekly lessons. Two grade bands are on sale: Sprouts (K-2) and Seedlings (grades 3-5), which teach different sets of 36 plants. Week 1 of each is free. Cultivators (grades 6-8) and Practitioners (grades 9-12) are planned.
- [Sprouts Printed Curriculum Set](https://edeninstitute.health/books#buy): All 36 weeks of Sprouts (K-2) in three printed books (Teacher's Guide, Student Notebook, Read-Aloud Storybook), $249 plus $12 shipping, printed to order and shipped in about two to three weeks. Extra Student Notebooks for siblings, $39.99 each, can be added at checkout.
- [Seedlings Printed Curriculum Set](https://edeninstitute.health/books#seedlings): All 36 weeks of Seedlings (grades 3-5) in three printed books (Teacher's Guide, Student Notebook, Read-Aloud Storybook), $249 plus $12 shipping, printed to order and shipped in about two to three weeks. Extra Student Notebooks for siblings, $39.99 each, can be added at checkout.
- [Sprouts 9-Week Starter Unit](https://edeninstitute.health/starter): Weeks 1 to 9 of Sprouts as an instant digital download, $39.
- [Seedlings 9-Week Starter Unit](https://edeninstitute.health/starter/seedlings): Weeks 1 to 9 of Seedlings as an instant digital download, $39.
- [Back to Eden: A Biblical Foundation for Herbal Healing](https://edeninstitute.health/back-to-eden): Camila Johnson's book, the framework behind everything The Eden Institute teaches, as a paperback, a spiral Study & Journal Edition, or a Study Guide, in print or as a download. Chapter 1 is free.
- [Free Body Pattern Assessment](https://edeninstitute.health/assessment): A short quiz that identifies your constitutional body pattern across the six tissue states.

## Scholarship and ESA families
- [Use your ESA or scholarship for Eden's Table](https://edeninstitute.health/esa): Eden's Table (Sprouts, grades K-2, and Seedlings, grades 3-5, Bible-based science and nature study) is an approved or registered vendor in seven education savings account and scholarship programs: Arizona ESA, Utah Fits All, Louisiana GATOR, Wyoming ESA, Arkansas EFA, Alabama CHOOSE Act and New Hampshire EFA. Each state page explains how buying works in that program right now, including where a marketplace listing is still pending.
- [Arizona ESA](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/arizona) · [Utah Fits All](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/utah) · [Louisiana GATOR](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/louisiana) · [Wyoming ESA](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/wyoming) · [Arkansas EFA](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/arkansas) · [Alabama CHOOSE Act](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/alabama) · [New Hampshire EFA](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/new-hampshire)
- [Curriculum specifications](https://edeninstitute.health/curriculum): Product specifications for scholarship programs and families: printed set (Sprouts or Seedlings) $261 total ($249 plus $12 shipping), 9-week starter (Sprouts or Seedlings) $39, extra student notebook (Sprouts or Seedlings) $39.99. Where a program's payment platform charges a vendor processing fee, the invoice shows it as its own line: in Arizona the set is $266.33 and an extra notebook $40.81. Arkansas, Alabama and New Hampshire invoices have no fee.

## Guides
- [Homeschool Help and Guides](https://edeninstitute.health/learn): Plain answers for homeschool families: choosing a Christian science and nature study curriculum, teaching several ages at one table, and bringing plants and Scripture into your school week.
- [How to Evaluate a Christian Homeschool Curriculum: A 10-Question Checklist](https://edeninstitute.health/learn/how-to-evaluate-christian-homeschool-curriculum): Ten questions to ask before you buy a Christian homeschool curriculum: does the faith go past the cover, will it fit your days, and can you try a week first?
- [Teaching Science to Multiple Ages at One Table](https://edeninstitute.health/learn/teaching-science-to-multiple-ages): How to teach homeschool science to several ages at once: one lesson, taught once, with the older child going further. What it looks like with real Week 1 pages.
- [Using Your ESA or Scholarship for a Christian Science and Nature Study Curriculum](https://edeninstitute.health/learn/esa-science-curriculum): Where Eden's Table is an approved or registered ESA and scholarship vendor, how ordering works in each state, and what to check before you order.
- [What I'm Using for Homeschool Science This Year (and Why It's Plants)](https://edeninstitute.health/learn/homeschool-science-this-year): This year I'm teaching Sprouts and Seedlings at home: one plant a week, learned by sight, smell and touch, with Scripture every week. Here's how it works.
- [Herbs in the Bible for Healing: What Scripture Says About God's Provision](https://edeninstitute.health/learn/herbs-in-the-bible): Healing herbs in the Bible, with verses: balm of Gilead, Hezekiah's figs, oil and wine, and the leaves for the healing of the nations.
- [Is Herbalism Witchcraft? What the Bible Says About Herbs](https://edeninstitute.health/learn/is-herbalism-witchcraft): No. Using the plants God made is not witchcraft. What Scripture actually forbids, why the enemy wants this ground, and how Christians take it back.
- [You're Qualified to Homeschool. Here's Why I Let My Teaching Certificate Lapse.](https://edeninstitute.health/learn/youre-qualified-to-homeschool): Yes, you're qualified. No state requires every homeschool parent to be a certified teacher. A 12-year classroom teacher on why she let her certificate lapse.
- [A Free Week of Christian Nature Study You Can Teach This Week](https://edeninstitute.health/learn/free-nature-study-week): One full week of Eden's Table, free: five lessons on one plant with the Teacher's Guide, Student Notebook and a read-aloud. Print it and teach it this week.
- [How to Choose an Herbal Homeschool Curriculum (K-5)](https://edeninstitute.health/learn/herbal-homeschool-curriculum): What to look for in an herbal homeschool curriculum: real plants, open-and-go lessons, the right grade level, and a faith lens that credits the Creator.
- [How to Teach Kids About Herbs at Home, One Plant a Week](https://edeninstitute.health/learn/how-to-teach-kids-about-herbs): The simplest way to teach kids about herbs: one plant a week. Read about it, draw it, try it in the kitchen, learn its story. Free first week inside.
- [Is Herbalism Biblical? What Christian Homeschool Families Should Know](https://edeninstitute.health/learn/is-herbalism-biblical): Yes, studying the plants God made is biblical. Where Scripture talks about plants, where Christians should be careful, and how to teach it to kids.
- [Look Inside Eden's Table: The Teacher's Guide, Notebook and Read-Aloud, Page by Page](https://edeninstitute.health/learn/inside-edens-table-flip-through): What the Eden's Table Teacher's Guide, Student Notebook and Read-Aloud look like inside, page by page, using the real Week 1 you can download free.
- [Switching Homeschool Science Mid-Year: How to Start Fresh in January](https://edeninstitute.health/learn/switching-homeschool-science-mid-year): Yes, you can switch science or add nature study at the semester break. A low-risk way to try: one free week, then nine weeks for $39, then the printed year.
